contract_assessments.assessment: [contract:A01; lean:Aiyagari1994/Aggregate/CrossSection.lean; lean:Aiyagari1994/Analysis/M06B/CrossSectionBridge.lean] The theorem quantifies over every household, real shift, resource probability law and policy-induced net-asset law. Its equivalence supplies both directions: resource invariance gives the resource image of rho×nu, and equality of that image with pi gives resource invariance. For the converse starting from a stationary asset marginal, set pi to its resource image; hrho is precisely reproduction of that marginal by saving. The helper proves the substantive nonstationary identity through measurable pushforward composition, product measures and the actual household kernel. Restoration is exact because (A(z)-phi)+phi=A(z)≥0. Independence concerns predetermined assets and fresh labor, not saving and contemporaneous labor. No existence, moment or continuum-aggregation conclusion is assumed. Original-budget interpretation retains the accepted normalization condition. The ledger and all eight export audits agree.

dimension_assessments.summary: For every pi and induced rho, the iff proves both stationary descriptions equivalent. Starting from a stationary asset marginal, take pi as its resource image; hrho expresses marginal reproduction.

Measurable pushforward composition and map_prod_map reduce the image to the household transition. The identity toNNReal((A-phi)+phi)=A holds pointwise. Composition-product identities then give exactly kernel composition with pi.

A(z)-phi is next-period predetermined net wealth, paired with fresh labor. Stationarity permits the current cross-sectional interpretation. Original-budget meaning remains conditional on intercept=-(R-1)*phi; arbitrary normalized shifts are not new debt-limit claims.

Rendered all six pages. A94 equations (7)/(8), printed 667/668, original PDF 10/11, support timing and shifted assets; A93 Proposition 5, printed 39–40, PDF 40–41, supplies invariance context. The explicit law equivalence is a new reconstruction.

Actual premises are HouseholdPrimitives and the induced-marginal equality; independence is the product construction. S05's smoothness, curvature, nondegeneracy and impatience remain required only when invoking its existence theorem.

hrho specifies the contracted induced marginal, not resource invariance. The helper holds before stationarity for every pi. No impossible, conclusion-equivalent extra premise or assumed existence enters.

Changes add the bridge, its helper and audit/import entries; accepted economic results are preserved. P01 supplies interpretation and S05 supplies optional existence, without strengthening either accepted result.

Resources remain all NNReal and net assets are real. Labor has an arbitrary probability law on its compact positive interval; no grid, finite support, density, endpoint mass or mean-one restriction is added.

The bridge uses policy continuity, including its feasibility-based zero extension, and exact nonnegative asset restoration. It invokes no marginal object and never substitutes rightMarginalValue m 0 for zeroRightMarginal.

The argument concerns probability measures and measurable maps only; it forms no real integral or ENNReal.toReal conversion. Real.toNNReal restores finite real shifted assets, with nonnegativity verified in the composite map.

A01 proves an exact one-step measure equality and an invariance equivalence, using no limit argument. It neither promotes S05's weak convergence to stronger convergence nor infers convergence or finiteness of moments.
Policy continuity and the bridge require no beta*R<1, consumption positivity, smoothness or curvature premise. Omitting impatience strengthens the identity and is explicitly documented.
Both new proofs use ordinary measure identities and rewriting. Controller checks report no prohibited patterns or sorry dependencies; all eight additions have assert_no_sorry coverage.
Each of the eight new exports has an axiom record and audit command. The controller's 494-record transitive union contains only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound.
The eight-name export, signature and axiom inventories match exactly. Both audit files cover every name with all three commands; the public signature includes precisely m, phi, pi, rho and hrho.

Markdown matches the exact iff, actual assumptions, restoration map and pushforward proof. It records REVIEW_READY and distinguishes optional S05 existence from A01; documentation compilation is controller-reported.

The maps use the canonical optimal saving policy and actual normalized resource transition. Clipping below -phi disappears identically on induced assets. The result establishes the intended iid stationary cross-section, with the inherited original-price normalization restriction.

The induced-marginal premise matches the contract and both implications are exported. Product-law independence is explicit; no continuum law of large numbers, canonical-law-only restriction or hidden moment premise replaces it.
New economic content is confined to the asset/labor maps and their resource-law identity. No aggregate budget, mean-asset continuity, equilibrium or other later-contract conclusion is implemented.

The inspected argument proves the assigned correspondence, sources support its economic interpretation, and complete audits support kernel integrity. Inherited restrictions remain operative; no unresolved adequacy blocker remains.

[context:qualifications] rightMarginalValue is economically meaningful only at positive states. Never interpret rightMarginalValue m 0 as the economic boundary marginal. That boundary is zeroRightMarginal : ENNReal and may be infinite; utilityZeroRightMarginal is a separate utility endpoint object. H06 and contract D02 use no marginal object; contract D03 and S02 use rightMarginalValue only after proving positivity. A01 uses no marginal object or boundary substitution.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] The maintained household scope is bounded utility, continuous resources and a general compact iid-income law. P03's two-point distribution establishes primitive consistency only and does not restrict the general law. Unbounded log/CRRA utility and serially correlated income remain outside scope. H01–H04 retain BASIC-only assumptions and constructed canonical objects without impatience. H01 is a bounded-continuous Bellman self-map on unbounded NNReal with beta contraction and a general labor law; actual actions lie in [0,z], with shares auxiliary. H02 constructs the canonical fixed point, proves uniqueness among bounded continuous fixed points and uniform value iteration, and bounds value using inf U and sup U over all nonnegative consumption. H03 establishes ordinary real convex-combination concavity and strict increase without derivatives. H04 constructs the unique actual shifted-asset maximizer, uses shares only at positive resources, handles zero by feasibility, and satisfies c(z)+A(z)=z. No CoreRegularity, impatience, differentiability, invariant-law, bounded-asset or finite-state assumption enters H01–H04.

[context:qualifications; dep:P01] P01 proves budget and borrowing-feasibility equivalence, not No-Ponzi. Equality and borrowing feasibility are separate components; original prices satisfy R=1+r, and the next-resource identity was separately proved. P02 finite-cap continuity fixes the cap and labor floor, treats r=0 separately and includes the zero-cap case without dividing by the cap. Its natural-cap branch requires r>0, gives -r*phi_nat=-w*l_min and effective income w*(l-l_min), and asserts no continuity of the raw natural borrowing limit through zero. P03's consistency witness does not establish optimization, stationarity or equilibrium.

[context:qualifications; lean:Aiyagari1994/Primitives/Basic.lean] M02B's lifetime interpretation is an absolutely convergent series of expected flows under finite-history product laws, covering admitted measurable full-history feasible plans. No literal infinite-product lifetime random variable is constructed. Translation to the original budget remains conditional on normalization from OriginalPrices. The normalized affine income intercept equals -(R-1)*phi when obtained through that bridge. S05 and S06 retain their normalized-coordinate interpretation; A01 does not remove the original-coordinate qualification.
